audience: video teams that host and track recordings in Wistia

useCases.title: Review plays and engagement
useCases.text: Read the stats of one video, then the account analytics for a date range, including the top content.

useCases.title: Find a video by text or tag
useCases.text: Search the account for media by text, tag or type, then open one item for its assets and URLs.

useCases.title: Check captions of a video
useCases.text: Open one video and list its caption tracks with their language and status.

useCases.title: Organize videos into a new folder
useCases.text: Create a folder, then move up to 100 media items into it. Wistia allows 10 move calls per 5 minutes.

useCases.title: Tag or rename media
useCases.text: Add tags to several media items at once, or change the name and description of one item.

useCases.title: Archive old recordings
useCases.text: Archive up to 100 media items, then poll the background job until it finishes. Archived media is hidden, not deleted.
